title: Best cooking class
text: Ari met us the door and it was the best cooking class we’ve done. Started off with a glass of bubbles then he took us back to our station where we smoked  bread with garlic and tomato. author: Bradford_W

title: A great cooking experience !
text: Fernando is at the top of his game! Our family (of 5 adults) participated in this sangria and paella cooking workshop. It ended up being a private class which was still a lot of fun. Although initially a little tricky to find, the setting is unique and well worth the trip. The workshop was so well organized. The sangria and paella were delicious. Fernando who is warm and welcoming, created a party-like atmosphere.
author: Rich_N

title: Learning and Limoncello
text: What a fun time! We cut veggies and calamari, we combined wine and fruits, and we stirred and created paella. It was wonderful. Tim, our chef, was knowledgeable and light hearted! We ended the night with a limoncello shot and access to the recipes.  I would totally recommend this class anytime  you are in Barcelona. Delicioso!
author: Amy_S
